title: Imec demonstrates logic and DRAM structures using High NA EUV Lithography

passages.note: Opening description and Steven Scheer statement. Imec reports random logic structures and a DRAM layout printed in single exposures with the 0.55 NA scanner at the joint Veldhoven lab. A 9.5 nm reported line size corresponds to a 19 nm pitch for that pattern. These were structures, before completed product or yield evidence.
